status: optional research reference scenarios;not manufacturer specifications or automatically adopted baseline

battery.scope: generic3MWh/1.5MW reference;transfer to other vendors/sizes requires explicit scenario label
battery.maintenance_warning: source formula/unit conflict;do not claim either interpretation is supplier-confirmed
battery.auxiliary_rule: Do not add a second copy of auxiliaries already in a whole-system RTE. Retain documented standby bounds;unpublished standby is not asserted zero.
battery.open_physical_fields: No unverified product DoD,PCS compatibility or mean efficiency is filled from these references

modern_installed_cost.source: IEA GHR2025 executive summary;not vendorquotation or all-scaleAEMestimate

electrolysis.no_double_count: Choose explicit replacements OR the annuitised stack-reserve VOM,not both.
electrolysis.do_not_scale_old_fraction_to_modern_cape: Old stack fraction belongs to the old plant package;do not multiply it by a different modern total installed price.

AEM_legacy_2022_reference.warning: Legacyassumptions,not aFlex/Nexus/Rheoslife guarantee;use only declared AEM-family sensitivity

electrolysis.water_rule: Apply product raw/purified flow definitions separately;site water price/RO recovery are external project inputs.
electrolysis.finance_rule: Keep quote currency,year and scope;do not compare an uninstalled EURprice directly with GBP2020 installedcost.
electrolysis.missing_product_quotes: Native supplier prices/historical orders stay in each product record. No invented product-specific quotation.
